92962.l: The Zygaenoidea are a superfamily of moths that include burnet moths, forester moths, and relatives.

92963.l: The Zygaenidae moths are a family of Lepidoptera. The majority of zygaenids are tropical, but they are nevertheless quite well represented in temperate regions. They are also sometimes called smoky moths.
